# NANJING ANGELA LABEL CO., LTD.

> > Manufacturer of woven labels, embroidery patches, military insignia, and garment accessories based in Nanjing, China.

NANJING ANGELA LABEL CO., LTD. specializes in custom textile embellishments including military epaulettes, cap badges, embroidered patches, woven labels, and webbing tape. The company holds ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF16949, and BSCI certifications, serving uniform, garment, and military accessory markets with both traditional handmade and modern heat transfer manufacturing techniques.

## Key Topics

- Embroidery patches and badges
- Military epaulettes and shoulder boards
- Woven labels and garment accessories
- Metal cap badges for military uniforms
- TPU patches and heat transfer logos
- Handmade silk embroidered brooches
- Bullion wire badges
- Webbing tape and elastic
- ISO 9001 and BSCI certified manufacturing
- OEKO-TEX 100 certified products
- Security arm badges
- Uniform accessories and insignia
- Custom label manufacturing
- Decorative badge wholesale
